virtualization_disclosure: On macOS, Docker Desktop / Colima executes containers within an arm64 Linux virtual machine. Containerized services (imgproxy, imgproxy_cached, and containerized Atihsrah) incur hypervisor context-switching, virtual network interface NAT translation, and guest kernel scheduling. Native services (Native Atihsrah and Thumbor) execute directly on macOS host silicon. To fairly isolate this virtualization delta, Atihsrah is benchmarked in both native and containerized modes.
